t: 伦敦几起早期火灾中最严重的一次将大部分城市烧为平地.
te: The most severe of several early fires of London burns most of the city to the ground.

dz: 拉斯·纳瓦斯·德·托洛萨战役:教宗英诺森三世召欧洲骑士为十字军后,卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索八世,纳瓦雷国王桑乔七世,阿拉贡国王彼得二世和葡萄牙国王阿丰索二世的军队击败了柏柏尔穆斯林领袖阿尔莫哈德的军队,从而标志着重新征服和西班牙中世纪史上的一个重要转折点.
de: Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa: After Pope Innocent III calls European knights to a crusade, the forces of kings Alfonso VIII of Castile, Sancho VII of Navarre, Peter II of Aragon and Afonso II of Portugal defeat those of the Berber Muslim leader Almohad, thus marking a significant turning point in the Reconquista and in the medieval history of Spain.

te: The Golden Bull of Sicily is issued to confirm the hereditary royal title in Bohemia for the Přemyslid dynasty.
